$comment: NuLumin design tokens. Read this before writing any layout, prompt, or CSS. Two palettes exist and they are NOT interchangeable — see `surfaces`.

disclosures.ruo: For Research Use Only. Not for Human Consumption.
disclosures.ruoLowercase: For Research Use Only. Not for human consumption.
disclosures.fdaLong: Not approved by the FDA. Not for human or veterinary use, or for use as drugs, food additives, or cosmetics.
disclosures.rule: The RUO line is mandatory on every consumer-facing asset and must be rendered deterministically (HTML/CSS or compositing), never asked of an image model. It stays legible for the full duration of a video.

marketing.$comment: The live nulumin.org design system. Use for ALL ads, carousels, video overlays, web and email graphics. This is the current system and supersedes the older Montserrat dark-token set.

packaging.$comment: Vial-label artwork ONLY. Sampled from the printed label PDFs; softer and warmer than the site palette. Never mix these hexes into a marketing layout, and never mix marketing hexes into label art.

assets.$comment: Curated, tracked artwork — present on a fresh clone. Logos ship with their original transparent padding; the brandkit bbox-trims and caches them. `scenePattern` is optional: generate scenes with hero-prompts.json and drop them in, or let the generator fall back to a CSS ground.
assets.$scenes: Shipped scenes are exactly the render size (1080 wide), so they are native resolution for every placement the ad generator produces — not proxies. Generate a fresh one at 4K with hero-prompts.json for anything larger, or for a compound with no scene yet. A missing scene is not an error: the dark formats fall back to a CSS ground plus the vial cutout.

typography.$comment: Four families, all on Google Fonts. `npm run content -- brandkit fonts nulumin` bundles them into an offline base64 CSS file; nothing here needs a network call at render time after the first bundle.

data.name: JetBrains Mono
data.role: proof chips, spec values, lot/COA data

label.name: Space Grotesk
label.role: eyebrows, uppercase labels, selling points, offers

rules: Headlines are Fraunces 300, SENTENCE CASE, and end in a period. Not bold. Not all-caps. This single rule is the brand's most recognizable typographic signature.
A headline's second clause is set in Fraunces italic 300 with a spectrum gradient clipped to the text.

When gradient text uses line-height below 1.0, add `padding-bottom:.16em; margin-bottom:-.16em` — background-clip:text only paints inside the element box, so italic descenders render as sliced-off stubs without it.
Eyebrows are Space Grotesk uppercase, letter-spacing .08–.14em, preceded by a short rounded accent bar.
Never use Montserrat. It belongs to the retired 2026-Q2 marketing pipeline.

devices.$comment: Signature elements lifted from the live site. An ad that carries three or more of these reads as NuLumin before the logo is even seen.
devices.announcementBar: Full-width cream (#F0EDE4) bar at the very top carrying the RUO line in #4B5563. Site convention; use on light layouts.
devices.spectrumBand: Five equal flex segments, 7px tall, in spectrum band order, pinned to the top edge. Present on every asset — the brand's distinguishing graphic device.
devices.accentTickEyebrow: 66x5px rounded accent bar + tracked uppercase Space Grotesk eyebrow.
devices.proofChips: Pill rows, 1px accent border at 35% + accent fill at 8%, JetBrains Mono label with a smaller muted sublabel. Tick glyph is ✓ in #4DC97A. Light layouts only.
devices.accentHaloAndFloor: Radial accent halo behind the product plus a narrow elliptical floor shadow — the site's plinth treatment. Light layouts only.
devices.pillCta: Fully rounded CTA. Light layouts: #7c6ff7 fill, white text. Dark layouts: white fill, ink text, 8px white ring at 12% and a deep drop shadow, with a trailing →.
devices.premiumFinish: Dark layouts get an inset 1px hairline frame at 17% white, a radial vignette, and an SVG fractalNoise grain layer at 10% opacity / overlay blend. These are what stop it reading as a generic digital layout.

prohibited: Energy-drink neon, brutalist or Swiss-poster palettes
Warping, recoloring, or re-lettering the logo lockup
Bullets, numerals, or middot friezes in place of the ✓ tick system
The word "stack" — use panel, series, or group (see AD_SYSTEM.md)
